📺🏈: Chad Powers

Russ Holliday may have lost his place in college football, but he’s not ready to walk away. With his career in ruins, he transforms himself into the completely unhinged Chad Powers and takes a shot at joining a struggling team. The plan is simple: get back on the field. The problem? Keeping Chad Powers believable while hiding who he really is. #HuluPartner

Glen Powell leads this hilarious sports comedy inspired by Eli Manning’s viral Chad Powers character. With football dreams, outrageous situations, and a whole lot of chaos, it’s a comeback story where getting a second chance means becoming the last person anyone would expect.

source_details.synopsis: Chad Powers is an American sports comedy television series created by Glen Powell and Michael Waldron, starring Powell in the titular role. Developed from an Omaha Productions skit by Eli Manning, the show follows Russ Holliday after he disgraces himself on the field while serving as a star quarterback at a major college program. After ruining his reputation, Holliday undergoes a physical transformation, with the help of prosthetics and a wig, to disguise his identity in order to join the floundering football team at an SEC school under the name of Chad Powers. The cast includes Steve Zahn, Toby Huss, Perry Mattfeld, Clayne Crawford, Wynn Everett, Frankie A. Rodriguez, Colton Ryan, Keese Wil
